text: But there is one part that I would look at differently. I would look at decay as a form of growth. Like a diet is not a bug but a feature. We are fundamentally looking at this wrong. That's why we, or at least many people, pursue this immortality as being better. No, it is not. But I mean, leave a thousand years. I'm not sure I want to live a thousand years. A thousand years is not that long.
